name: Biology PhD
detailsNote: Available official requirements; older handbook conditions and undated dates qualified. Admission model omitted if not established.

english.note: Central minimum. US accredited degree or official transcript/direct registrar attestation confirming sole English instruction can satisfy proficiency. DET may be evaluated by ESL professional. Program may set higher standard.

applicationFee.note: Domestic fee 65. Conditional waiver for US military veterans or spouses/dependents with qualifying benefits documentation. No explicit citizenship rule stated; international applicants must confirm qualification. No general hardship waiver established. Biology FAQ says no waivers but invites hardship applicants to contact DGS; departmental waiver not promised.

requirements.note: Accredited bachelor, no MS prerequisite; GPA 2.75 undergraduate/3 graduate central minimum. CV and personal statement~2–3 single-spaced pages. Faculty contact and research-fit identification recommended, not mandatory.

funding.note: Only fully funded PhDs admitted via TA/RA: stipend, full health insurance, tuition scholarship covering most student fees. No separate assistantship application.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall full consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Programme lists Fall 2027 recruiting faculty, but date year not attached; earlier than older January 1 target.
